strings.Kamu menyimpan tautan menu, nama akun, n: You save the menu link, account name, number and destination account, then report it to the platform, Komdigi Content Complaints, andreport.go.id. You also tell friends who might receive a similar promotion.
strings.Rekaman suara beberapa detik cukup untuk: A few seconds of voice recording is enough to create a voice clone. Scammers use panic and secrecy to keep you from checking. Hang up the phone and call your family via the number you saved to yourself.
strings.Kamu menyimpan nama grup, nomor admin, d: You save the group name, admin number, domain, destination account, and dashboard screenshot. You report it to the platform, Komdigi Content Complaints, andreport.go.id, then warn other group members.
strings.Penjual menolak escrow dan berhenti memb: Seller refused escrow and stopped replying. You're not losing money, but you're losing that bargain — which apparently never existed. The platform flagged his account after several other reports came in.
strings.Kamu mengirim OTP. Tiga hari kemudian mu: You send an OTP. Three days later a transaction of IDR 3,200,000 appears in your bank application for a “digital subscription” that you never purchased. Card numbers and CVVs have been sold, and OTP opens the final door.
strings.Tingkat keparahan menunjukkan besar keru: The severity level indicates the magnitude of the loss and the difficulty of recovery, not how often the mode occurs. Each card contains red flags, verification steps, and reporting channels that can be used today.
strings.Kamu meminta kontrak lengkap, alamat per: You ask for a complete contract, company address, and placement permit number. The agent said it was a “confidential document” and then stopped replying. No money is moving around — and no jobs are really there.
strings.Kamu mengirim kode keluarga dan OTP. Pen: You send the family code and OTP. The fraudster used this access to try other transactions, while the hospital stated that there was no patient named Raka. The sound on the phone is cloned from an old video.
strings.Kamu menutup telepon dan menghubungi cal: You hang up the phone and contact the official call center from the application. The fake transaction never took place, and no money came out. The scammer tries again tomorrow with another number — you already know the pattern.
strings.Seorang kenalan mengundangmu ke grup “Fa: An acquaintance invites you to the “Fable Trading VIP” group. Observe who is speaking, who is giving praise, and when the lone skeptical voice is silenced. No money changes in this module — just observations.
strings.Kamu menutup halaman verifikasi dan mene: You close the verification page and call Raka on the number you saved. Raka is healthy and never calls. You didn't lose any money, but the fake voice almost made you leak the family code.
strings.Kamu memblokir nomor itu, menyimpan bukt: You block the number, save chat evidence, and report it. A job offer that asks for an upfront fee is not worth trusting, even if the letter looks official. You save IDR 4,500,000 and your passport data.
strings.Kamu membayar Rp 4.650.000 untuk pinjama: You pay IDR 4,650,000 for a loan of IDR 3,000,000 — 55% more in 14 days. There is no terror because you paid on time, but you still lose money and your contact data is already in their hands.
strings.Kamu mengirim PIN dan OTP melalui halama: You sent the PIN and OTP via a fake page. The IDR 350,000 funds moved again, then another transaction appeared in the account. The seller never delivers the order; Your banking data is enough to take over access.
strings.Kamu mengisi recovery phrase. Dalam hitu: You fill in the recovery phrase. In a matter of seconds, all assets in the wallet were moved to another address. Fraudsters don't need your password; recovery phrase is a full key. The IDR 3,000,000 deposit was also not returned.
strings.Kamu menutup CairDuit dan mengecek dafta: You close CairDuit and check the list of licensed lenders at the OJK. Legal alternatives have clearer fees and do not require contact access. The process is slower, but there are no terrors waiting behind.
strings.Kamu menutup halaman sebelum mengirim OT: You close the page before sending the OTP, then call the bank from the number on the back of the card. Card blocked and replaced. Card data may be recorded, but without an OTP fraudsters cannot complete large transactions.
strings.Tiket konser yang sah punya nomor pesana: Legitimate concert tickets have an order number, name of the orderer, and status on the official platform account. Don't judge authenticity from design images or seller's promises. Before paying, ask for the ticket code and check directly on the official channel.
strings.Kamu meneruskan dana itu. Tiga hari kemu: You pass on the funds. Three days later your account is blocked and your balance is held. Investigators discovered the flow of money from fraud victims to your account, then to three other accounts. Rio disappears; your name is on file.
strings.Kamu mentransfer Rp 5.500.000 ke rekenin: You transfer IDR 5,500,000 to a personal account. The seller promised to send a receipt, then stopped replying. The number is inactive and the listing is gone. There is no buyer protection because transactions occur outside the platform.
strings.Kamu membayar Rp 1.200.000 tambahan. Sal: You pay IDR 1,200,000 additionally. The dashboard balance still cannot be withdrawn, the admin blocked you, and the destination account is empty. Total loss IDR 4,200,000. The profit figure is just writing on a page created by fraudsters.
strings.Kamu mengirim uang sekali lagi. Tidak la: You send money once again. Not long after, the admin deleted the chat, removed you from the group, and the number was inactive. There are no commissions ever really — just three small payments to make you believe it.
strings.Sebelum memindai, pastikan nama merchant: Before scanning, make sure the merchant name in the payment application is the same as the name of the shop you are contacting. QRIS can be re-attached or sent by another party. Scanning and paying is not proof that your order is recorded in the store.
strings.Kamu menutup halaman palsu dan membuka a: You close the fake page and open the bank application. The payment never went to Bu Rani's Kitchen because the merchant name didn't match. You cancel the order and look for a shop with QRIS that displays the correct business name.
strings.Kamu membacakan kode. Petugas mengucapka: You read the code. The officer thanked him and hung up. Two minutes later your account balance is empty. The bank never calls to ask for an OTP — it's a fraudster who calls using a regular cell phone number.
strings.Simpan tangkapan layar, nomor pengirim,: Save the screenshot, sender number, time and link before deleting. Report it to your mobile operator and fraud number complaint channel, then block the number. Don't forward SMS to other people because the links are still dangerous.
strings.Penipu menyalin foto, menu, dan ulasan r: Fraudsters copy photos, menus and reviews of real restaurants, then create new accounts with similar names. DP and additional fees are requested into a personal account. Order via official channels and do not transfer until the address and number match.
strings.Kamu mengisi data kartu dan membayar Rp: You fill in your card data and pay IDR 1,500,000. A few hours later another transaction appeared on the card. The e-ticket was never issued, and the seller's number is inactive. The card data you provide can be used for other purchases.
strings.Kamu mencari alamat dan nomor Bu Sari Ca: You look for the address and number of Bu Sari Catering via the official application. The promo account used real restaurant photos and menus, but not their ordering channels. You order via official channels and do not transfer the DP to a personal account.
strings.Kamu menyimpan tangkapan layar, nomor re: You save screenshots, account numbers and mutations. Your report goes to the official channel, and the recipient's account is marked. The money may not come back, but you stop the next flow — and have proof in case there are other victims.
strings.Pembayaran QRIS Rp 350.000 masuk ke reke: The QRIS payment of IDR 350,000 went into Andi Pratama's personal account. Bu Rani's Kitchen said it never received payment and had no orders in your name. The QRIS code was apparently sent from another account disguised as a shop.
strings.Buka daftar penyelenggara pinjaman beriz: Open the list of licensed loan providers at OJK or call 157. Match the name of the business entity, not the name of the application. Read total returns, admin fees, fines and permissions requested. Legal Pinjol does not ask for contact or gallery access.
strings.Kamu bertanya nama guru SD dan warna tas: You ask the name of the elementary school teacher and the color of Raka's bag. The caller faltered, then hung up. You called Raka on his old number and he was at home. Votes can be faked; Family knowledge and numbers you keep to yourself are not.
strings.Simpan chat, nomor rekening, dan mutasi: Save chats, account numbers and mutations before blocking Rio. Report it to the bank, OJK 157, and the police. Tell them that you were asked to receive and then forward the funds. Reporting early helps you prove that you are not part of the network.
strings.Tutup telepon, jangan gunakan tautan dar: Hang up, do not use the caller's link, then contact the family via the saved number. Ask people closest to you to answer questions that aren't on social media. If the money has been sent, contact the bank and save all evidence.
strings.Kamu membatalkan pengajuan dan mencabut: You cancel the application and revoke all app permissions, then delete it. No debt, no contact data uploaded. You can solve your urgent needs through other channels that don't risk your entire contact list.
strings.Terima kasih sudah menutup telepon. Kami: Thank you for hanging up. We did not find a transaction of IDR 4,750,000 in account 8820. No officer contacted the customer to ask for an OTP. If the card is ever inserted into a suspicious link, reply “BLOCK” in the app.
strings.Kamu mentransfer Rp 15.000.000 ke rekeni: You transfer IDR 15,000,000 to Dimas Saputra's account. The live caller number is inactive. When you call Raka on his old number, he is at home and has never had an accident. His voice was recorded from social media posts.
strings.Tutup telepon. Buka aplikasi bank dari i: Hang up. Open the bank app from the icon on your phone, not from a link. Check for mutations. If there is an unknown transaction, contact the call center on the application or back of the card. The bank won't be mad at you hanging up; scammers who will panic.
strings.Kamu tidak bisa membayar tepat waktu. De: You can't pay on time. Fines run every day, all your contacts are contacted, and your photos are edited and shared. The illegal app has no office to go to; the only thing left is the ever-growing debt.
strings.Kamu menutup halaman sebelum mengisi for: You close the page before filling in the form, then open the bank application and call the official call center. No data is leaked. The page uses a lookalike domain and a “secure” lock to reassure you — you check the address, not the icon.
strings.Simpan surat, chat, nomor rekening, dan: Save letters, chats, account numbers and proof of transfer before blocking. Report to the Ministry of Manpower, BP2MI, recipient bank, and chat platform. If you have transferred, immediately contact the bank to request freezing of the destination account and make a police report.
strings.Kamu menutup chat dan memblokir admin. T: You close the chat and block the admin. Those three small commissions remain in your simulated balance, but you never send a deposit. Your biggest loss is simply time — and it's much cheaper than the same lesson with real money.
strings.Scamurai adalah alat edukasi komunitas,: Scamurai is a community education tool, not legal, financial, or psychological advice. The certificate is not an official certification. If you are experiencing fraud, prioritize saving money and data, then use the official channels in the Help Center.
strings.Buka aplikasi kurir resmi atau ketik ala: Open the official courier application or type in the official address yourself, then enter the receipt number. Do not fill in card data for shipping costs. If the card data has already been sent, contact the bank, block the card, and monitor the transaction. Save the original SMS as evidence.
strings.Kamu mentransfer Rp 4.500.000. Agen meng: You transfer IDR 4,500,000. The agent sent a “processing” sticker, then the number was inactive. The offer letter never came from any company; the address and permission do not exist. Your money goes into your personal account and is withdrawn within minutes.
strings.Kamu menutup halaman penarikan sebelum m: You close the withdrawal page before paying taxes or filling in the recovery phrase. The IDR 3,000,000 deposit may have been lost, but you didn't increase the loss and didn't leak the wallet key. Contact the bank and report the recipient's account immediately.
strings.Tutup telepon. Buka aplikasi bank dari i: Hang up. Open the bank app from the icon on your phone, not from a link. Check for mutations. If there is an unknown transaction, contact the call center listed on the application or back of the card. The bank won't be mad at you hanging up; scammers who will panic.
strings.Kamu mencari nama platform di daftar ped: You search for the platform name in the list of licensed crypto asset traders and don't find it. The destination account is also in a personal name. You don't deposit, block admins, and save evidence. No profits are lost because there is no real investment.
strings.Cek nama perusahaan dan izin P3MI di kan: Check the company name and P3MI permit on the official Ministry of Manpower channel. Call the company on the number you searched for yourself, not the number from the chat. Ask for an employment contract that includes the position, salary, working hours and who covers the visa. Recruitment costs should not be passed on to workers.
strings.Setelah menutup telepon, buka aplikasi b: After hanging up the phone, open the bank application and check the statement. If you give the card number, block the card and ask for a replacement. Enable transaction notifications and two-step verification. Save the official call center number in your contacts so that next time you don't have to look for the number from SMS.
strings.Membatalkan pengajuan belum cukup. Buka: Canceling the application is not enough. Go to your phone's settings, revoke contacts, gallery, location, and SMS permissions for that app, then delete the app. Ask for written proof of cancellation and check that no data has been uploaded. If there has already been a transfer, block the destination account and report it to the bank.
strings.Komisi kecil dibayar → tugas naik → depo: Small commission paid → task goes up → deposit → “system error” → deposit again. Every time you pay, the scammer adds another reason for you to pay again to save your previous money. This is called sunk cost: affection for money that has already been spent. The only way to stop is to stop now.
strings.Jangan gunakan, jangan pecah, dan jangan: Don't use it, don't break it, and don't pass on the funds. Contact the bank via the official number, explain that the funds came in without any basis, and request a reversal of the transaction. Save mutations and conversations as evidence. Accounts can be temporarily frozen during an inspection, but that is much better than engaging in money laundering.
strings.Menjadi korban penipuan bukan tanda keku: Being a victim of fraud is not a sign of deficiency. Scammers practice their scripts on thousands of people and choose moments when we are tired, panicked, or in need of money. You don't have to do it alone: ​​tell someone you trust, write down a timeline, and take a break from the screen. If you experience persistent anxiety or thoughts of self-harm, contact mental health professionals or local emergency services. Scamurai is not a counseling service.
